objective: Demonstrate a repeatable >=5% full-model decode throughput improvement across the locked contexts; pursue 10–20% with correct fusion and scheduling. These are goals, not predictions.
authorization: Human explicitly approved a new round of up to three substantial candidates after the previous round exhausted its cap. Prior snapshots and failures remain intact; only three new IDs/snapshots may be evaluated in this round.

confirmation.primer_policy: Both lanes get one same-lane fresh-cache primer; retain swap-only flags, stop other hard failures. No state-file serialization or weight exchange between primer and measured request.
confirmation.threshold: Each of four candidate blocks must have paired median ratio >=1.05 and bootstrap95 lower bound >max(1.05,1+fresh A/A noise). All three A/A groups must pass. Every measured row must meet strict power/thermal/paging policy and match reference tokens. Otherwise improvement remains unproven.

numerical_policy: Existing pointwise BF16 tolerance .02+.02*abs(reference); finite/shape/dtype/cache checks. Preserve native MXFP4 values and BF16 activations/cache. Retain route/token/cache differences. Confirmation requires full128 numerical comparisons at all three contexts with matching token and route-set trajectories. Exact weight reconstruction is mandatory; output bit-exactness remains diagnostic.
model_loading: One native model load on CPU outside timing. Slot1 controller serializes exact native and packed vocabulary backing stores, verifies all actual matrix BF16 words, and restores baseline storage bit-exactly. Before each lane, release the previous representation, clear cached allocations, and fully materialize only the selected representation. This conversion is outside request timing, logged separately, and precedes cooldown and environment observation. No checkpoint reloading or conversion is hidden inside a measured request.
memory_checks: Baseline native vocabulary bytes must equal original size with zero packed bytes. Candidate must retain zero native vocabulary bytes and exactly the packed allocation. Native multi-token fallback is exact lazy reconstruction using unchanged linear arithmetic; any evaluated fallback temporary is included in request memory. Backing-file identities checked per operation; full hashes checked at command and worker closure. Preparation may transiently retain both representations and reports that overhead separately.
scheduling: Luna high executes prepared scripts, monitors actual process handles and collects artifacts. Primary designs/implements/interprets. Only one GPU worker. No broad profiling. Worker waits at most30minutes for next controller command and has a ten-hour total cap. No automatic restart, speculative extra forwards or omitted final drain.
claims: Exploration and warmups select hypotheses only. Old timing is never reused as fresh confirmation. Preserve all failed records, calibration/correctness, samples and hashes. Held-out task quality remains planned; no acceptance, commit, push, merge or publication is authorized.
